verdict.rationale: The screenshot guide documents rendering a URL and returning a viewport, full-page, or offset capture in PNG, JPEG, or WebP, with an option to choose the capture area. Scrape can also return a screenshot alongside other outputs. Full-page capture is explicit, but area selection is described only as "offset" or "choose the capture area", with no detail on arbitrary region coordinates or element-selector capture. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of arbitrary region/element-selector capture, independent or hands-on corroboration.
